# `gcp.networkattachment`

A network attachment is a resource that lets a producer Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) network initiate connections to a consumer VPC network through a Private Service Connect interface.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/NetworkAttachment` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
